shots.label: BORDERSTAMP
shots.headline:
We never say, “Papers, please!”

Cross a border and automatically get a new stamp
shots.alt: “We never say, ‘Papers, please!’ Cross a border and automatically get a new stamp” and an iPhone showing 35 country stamps, newest first, each with its flag and the date it was earned: Australia, Estonia, Czechia, Germany, Italy, Switzerland, France and Ireland

shots.label: SOMETHING FOR EVERYONE
shots.headline:
Never travelled internationally? 

No problem!
shots.alt: “Never travelled internationally? No problem!” and an iPhone showing 8 U.S. state stamps, each on a Stars and Stripes design: California, Hawaii, New York, Louisiana, Texas, Nevada, Alaska and Washington

shots.label: CUSTOM STAMP SETS
shots.headline:
Countries, states, territories, historical places

Get custom stamps no-one else has
shots.alt: “Countries, states, territories, historical places. Get custom stamps no-one else has” and an iPhone showing Borderstamp’s Store. Cold War Countries is featured with a West Berlin stamp from Checkpoint Charlie: “You’ve already crossed nine borders in Cold War Europe”, $1.99. Below it, stamp sets for U.S. States, Japanese Prefectures and Australian States

shots.label: ALREADY BEEN THERE?
shots.headline:
Add your own history

Easily, quickly, on‑device
shots.alt: “Add your own history. Easily, quickly, on-device” and an iPhone showing stamps from 2002 and 2003: the Netherlands, Kerry in Ireland, Ireland, the United Kingdom, Thailand, Okinawa, Hokkaido and Japan

shots.label: MAPS & STATS
shots.headline:
Where have you been?

It’s not a contest, but it kinda is
shots.alt: “Where have you been? It’s not a contest, but it kinda is” and two iPhones. One shows a Home Screen with two Borderstamp widgets: a world map with 30 of 235 countries visited, and 68 stamps from 30 countries and 56 regions. The other shows the Map tab with U.S. states, 8 of 56 visited, including Alaska, California and Texas

shots.label: WHAT GOES ON TOUR, STAYS ON TOUR
shots.headline:
Everything is private

No-one is tracking you

We never see where you’ve been, and neither does anyone else
shots.alt: A simple slide saying, “What goes on tour, stays on tour. Everything is private. No-one is tracking you. We never see where you’ve been, and neither does anyone else.”
